roleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Airport Baggage Systems
jobDescription: The airport baggage systems business installs and upgrades baggage handling systems under fixed-price contracts with airport operators. The Senior Project Manager is the project manager of record on installation projects: signs the project charter and the contractual milestone certificates, holds the project budget under the business's delegated limits, runs the night-time cut-overs with the airport operator, and directs the site project engineers. Prior experience as project manager of record on airport or comparable live-operations installations is required, together with the PMP or an equivalent recognised project management credential. Reports to the head of projects; works with the airport operators, the site teams and the commercial team.
requirements: Has been the project manager of record on airport or comparable live-operations installations, signing the charter and the milestone certificates.
Holds the PMP or an equivalent recognised project management credential.
Holds the project budget under the business's delegated limits.
Runs cut-overs with the operator and directs the site project engineers under a documented cut-over method.
Documents project boundaries, risks and hand-over conditions at each milestone.

evidence.text: Senior Project Manager and project manager of record on three airport baggage system installations for a systems integrator between 2020 and 2025, signing the project charters and the contractual milestone certificates for each; before that, three years as a site project engineer on two installations.
PMP credential held since 2019 and current; credential number and the institute's registry entry available for verification.
Held the project budget for each installation under the business's delegated limits, with the monthly cost reports to the head of projects filed in the project folders.

Ran the night-time cut-overs with the airport operators under the business's cut-over method, directing the site project engineers through the cut-over plan and the fallback checklist at each of the three sites.
Wrote the project boundary statement, the risk register and the hand-over conditions submitted with each milestone certificate.

Work sample: one signed project charter, two signed milestone certificates, one cut-over plan with its fallback checklist and the credential certificate, with the project folder references as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said he was project manager of record on three airport installations and holds a current PMP; the site count, the credential year and the cut-over method he described match the resume.
Hiring manager pre-read: the head of projects asks the packet to cite the signed charters and milestone certificates and the credential registry entry, and to show the site engineer years separately.

propositions.text: The candidate has been Senior Project Manager and project manager of record on three airport baggage system installations for a systems integrator between 2020 and 2025, signing the project charters and the contractual milestone certificates, after three years as a site project engineer on two installations.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the signed charter and the milestone certificates document the project manager role.

propositions.text: The candidate holds a current PMP credential since 2019 and held the project budget for each installation under the business's delegated limits with monthly cost reports to the head of projects.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the credential certificate document the credential and the budget responsibility.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the night-time cut-overs with the airport operators under the business's cut-over method, directing the site project engineers through the cut-over plan and fallback checklist, and wrote the boundary statement, risk register and hand-over conditions for each milestone.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the cut-over plan document the cut-overs and the milestone documents.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the project manager role, the credential, the budget, the cut-overs and the milestone documents.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: The project manager role and the credential are documented in the resume, the signed charters and the certificate; the site engineer years are shown separately.
followUpTargets: Ask for the PMP credential number so the registry entry can be checked.
